page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine provisioned on KVM infrastructure. It runs on the x86_64 architecture and utilizes Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a nominal clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance offers 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 128.0 GB of memory, establishing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The dedicated CPU configuration guarantees that execution threads remain isolated from noisy neighbors, sustaining predictable compute behavior under concurrent processing loads.

For networking and input/output demands, the instance is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, enabling sustained network communication for inter-node clustering and distributed services. Local disk storage is completely absent from this profile, with local storage capacity rated at zero gigabytes. Storage must be provisioned externally using cloud block storage, which decouples persistent storage lifecycle from virtual machine compute lifecycles while requiring appropriate network storage bandwidth planning.

The resource configuration is tailored for balanced efficiency across traditional enterprise application tiers. Without bundled GPUs or integrated local NVMe drives, operational costs focus strictly on compute capacity, memory density, and baseline network throughput. This balance makes ecs.g8i.8xlarge suited for medium-sized relational databases, in-memory caching systems, CI/CD build nodes, microservices orchestration, and multi-tier web serving environments requiring robust single-thread and parallel CPU performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8i.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 8475B vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Designed around a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory allocation, the instance provides 128.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB per vCPU. Virtualized on a KVM hypervisor, it delivers consistent dedicated core execution without hardware oversubscription. Network connectivity features a 20 Gbps baseline throughput, supporting reliable ingress and egress for communication across distributed infrastructure. The server includes no onboard local storage, necessitating reliance on remote network-attached block volumes for persistent state, which provides operational flexibility in storage scaling. With zero physical GPU accelerators, this configuration delivers balanced compute density and qualitative resource efficiency for non-accelerated enterprise workloads, including relational database management, multi-tier web serving, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, and general enterprise application hosting.
